pretreatments.description: Chemical pretreatment using sodium hydroxide (NaOH) at 8% w/w concentration. Conditions tested included incubation temperatures at 0°C and 100°C, with retention times ranging from 10 to 60 minutes. This treatment was designed to reduce crystallinity of cellulose and eliminate lignin resistance, increasing surface area and improving digestibility.

Physical preparation of pine wood samples, including debarking, cutting, grinding, and screening to achieve a homogeneous particle size of less than 1 mm. This step prepares the substrate before chemical treatment and improves surface area for potential biogas production.
